eld.text: Ardenvale began when mankind overthrew the Elven Lords from the mesa that would become [[Castle Ardenvale]], founding five knightly courts around the Circle of Loyalty.
For its knights it was home, and Syr Ameril pictured the castle so that her last thoughts would be of home as dragonfire raced toward her.

Within its kitchen, Syr Ginger awoke as Garruk broke in, fell into a cauldron when his axe separated her from the gingerbread man, and then leaped at him with a fork to avenge the gingerbread man's death.
Months later, Rowan and Will decided to quest for their father, and in the wider story Ardenvale fell to the Phyrexian invaders, with Algenus and Linden killed in its defense.

woe.text: Rowan dreamed of a feast where her parents told her to come to Castle Ardenvale, where her blood awaited her, and she woke resolved to go.
She blasted through Ardenvale's gates and fought her way up through slumbering knights attacking her, where Eriette had reanimated the sleepers as her court with Ashiok.

Kellan and Ruby leaped the gates with a frog potion, but Rowan knocked them out, until Will's knights burst in and Rowan and Will confronted each other, he pleading for her to come home and she answering that home was gone.

Ashiok took control of the sleepers until Will struck them with a bolt of ice and made them vanish; Eriette was captured, and Rowan blasted the floor and escaped, vowing to bring the blessed slumber to all of Eldraine.

fdn.text: Syr Ameril pictured Castle Ardenvale as a blaze approached, so that her last thoughts would be of home.
